title: Biquad Filter
text: 对双二次 IIR (SOS) 滤波器进行建模，输入 4 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Scale values} 指定缩放值；{Coefficient source} 指定操作模式、{Filter} 指定滤波器对象的名称、{Filter structure} 指定滤波器结构、{SOS Matrix (Mx6)} 指定 SOS 矩阵、{Initial conditions} 指定初始条件、{Initial conditions on zeros side} 指定零点侧的初始条件、{Initial conditions on poles side} 指定极点侧的初始条件、{Scale values mode} 指定缩放值的模式 Specify via input、{Action when the a0 values of the SOS matrix are not one} 指定 SOS 矩阵的 a0 值不为 1 时的操作、{Optimize unity scale values} 指定优化单位缩放值、{Input processing} 指定输入处理 Columns as channels、{View Filter Response} 指定查看滤波器响应、{Rounding mode} 指定舍入模式 Floor、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定溢出操作的方法、{Section input} 指定节输入数据类型 Same、{Section output} 指定节输出数据类型 Same as section、{Multiplicand} 指定被乘数数据类型 Same、{Coefficients} 指定系数数据类型 Same word length、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型 Same、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型 Same as product、{States} 指定状态数据类型 Same、{Output} 输出数据类型 Same、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 指定锁定数据类型设置，按实例取值。

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: 操作模式 Dialog parameters (default) | Input port(s) | Filter object

params.name: Filter
params.values: 滤波器对象的名称 BQF (default) | dsp.BiquadFilter System object name

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: 滤波器结构 Direct form II transposed (default) | Direct form I | Direct form I transposed | Direct form II

params.name: SOS Matrix (Mx6)
params.values: SOS 矩阵 [1 0.3 0.4 1 0.1 0.2] (default) | M -by-6 matrix

params.name: Scale values
params.values: 缩放值 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Initial conditions
params.values: 初始条件 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Initial conditions on zeros side
params.values: 零点侧的初始条件 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Initial conditions on poles side
params.values: 极点侧的初始条件 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Scale values mode
params.values: 指定缩放值的模式 Specify via input port (g) (default) | Assume all are unity and optimize

params.name: Action when the a0 values of the SOS matrix are not one
params.values: SOS 矩阵的 a0 值不为 1 时的操作 Warning (default) | None | Error

params.name: Optimize unity scale values
params.values: 优化单位缩放值 on (default) | off

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 输入处理 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: View Filter Response
params.values: 查看滤波器响应 button

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 溢出操作的方法 off (default) | on

params.name: Section input
params.values: 节输入数据类型 Same as input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Section output
params.values: 节输出数据类型 Same as section input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Multiplicand
params.values: 被乘数数据类型 Same as output (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: 系数数据类型 Same word length as input (default) | Specify word length | Binary point scaling

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Same as input (default) | Inherit via internal rule | Binary point scaling

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Same as product output (default) | Same as input | Binary point scaling

params.name: States
params.values: 状态数据类型 Same as accumulator (default) | Same as input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Same as accumulator (default) | Same as input | Binary point scaling

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 锁定数据类型设置 off (default) | on
